guitar.evidence: Jobim was primarily a pianist/composer; though he played guitar on some recordings, no single documented signature guitar.
guitar.notes: Bossa nova guitar parts on his recordings were often played by others (e.g. João Gilberto on his own songs); no canonical Jobim guitar.
